topic: 3D build story: a garden shed that keeps growing upward (continuity version)
taste: One structure from first frame to last; every addition is attached and stays on screen. Our own world and story.

claims.claim: A shed should not sit directly on grass; it needs a solid, level base.
A common base is compacted hardcore with sand on top, then paving slabs, checked with a spirit level.
Treated timber bearers lift the shed floor off the base so air can flow and damp is kept away.
